input: Write a short story for a literary magazine submission

gold.taskTitle: Write and Submit a Short Story to Literary Magazine
gold.taskDescription: Write an original short story tailored for submission to a literary magazine.

questions.title: Which specific literary magazine are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the exact publication the user has in mind for submission.

questions.title: What genre or tone should the story have?
questions.description: Determine whether the story should be literary fiction, horror, romance, humour, or another genre.

questions.title: Do you have a story idea or premise already?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a concept, characters, or plot in mind, or needs to develop one from scratch.

questions.title: What is the magazine's stated word count limit?
questions.description: Establish the required or preferred length for the submission.

questions.title: What is the submission deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Identify the date by which the story must be submitted.

questions.title: Have you submitted to this magazine or any other before?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience with literary submissions to calibrate the guidance needed.

questions.title: Do you want help writing, editing, or just planning?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs full writing support, revision feedback, or only a structured action plan.
